Chapter 6991: A World

Chapter 6991: A World

“Rumble!” Their conversation was interrupted since they had entered a different world.

The land plot landed and saw a peaceful horizon with warm sunlight. Both Till Ancestor and Mo Xiangsheng stepped out of the house to enjoy the scenery.

“Dusk Realm.” Mo Xiangsheng commented.

Li Qiye also took a look at the vast world filled with life just like one of the nine major worlds, albeit with far fewer living beings.

Till Ancestor tried but couldn’t see the end of this world, let alone Mo Xiangsheng.

They saw prosperous zones with kingdoms and sects participating in cultivation. Of course, the majority of the land was still pristine and unexcavated.

Thus, it had a long way to go before being comparable to the nine major worlds. However, it exceeded any of the minor ones.

“This is a real world?” Mo Xiangsheng found this inconceivable.

“Of course.” Till Ancestor said.

“It is as vast as any major world.” He said.

“Dusk was a celestial immortal, it makes sense that his corpse can create something like this.” Till Ancestor said.

Celestial immortals possessed apex powers, only second to the high heaven. Once killed, their body, true blood, essences, and dao mysteries returned to the world.

“Does this count as creating life?” Mo Xiangsheng asked.

“Can the dead create life?” Till Ancestor said.

“Right, then who created this world?” He asked.

“The high heaven, and this is a type of derivation, not creation.” Till Ancestor explained.

“I see.” He understood the distinction.

Till Ancestor then focused on scanning the realm, hoping to find the celestial source.

As the scan progressed, he was surprised to see a lack of dangerous areas. He said: “It’s a clean death, no malice or corruption at all.”

Heavenfall was the opposite example. Of course, he only lost his body, not his true fate.

Dusk Realm should have been peaceful and separated from the outside worlds. However, the fortress race built a direct passage to cross Ruin and Heavenfall Path.

This place potentially had something called a celestial dao court. Heavenfall was still alive and took his dao mysteries with him. On the other hand, Dusk’s dao mysteries were left behind to form a dao court of the celestial level.

With the recent changes came an influx of cultivators, mostly immortals and a few overlords. They broke the serenity by chasing after visual phenomena.

For example, immortal rays erupting, fluctuating treasure hymns, emerging palaces and runes...

They hoped to find the celestial source or celestial dao court. Of course, any other treasure belonging to Dusk would do.
